verdict.rationale: Convex's docs describe it as a reactive database with real-time sync so users instantly see the latest data and apps live-update. Convex engineers on HN explain the mechanism: active subscriptions track readsets and queries rerun only when a committed write touches their dependencies, with no polling. An outside commenter praises the model. Missing for 10: first-party docs detailing the client-side subscription API (e.g., hooks or framework bindings), and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor-staff explanations.
